entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your full name to pull up the account?
Jordan Miller. The device is defective.

Okay, Jordan, I see your account. Thank you for being a VeloFit VIP member. I'm sorry to hear there's an issue with your new band. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The pulse sensor is not working. It's completely broken.
I see. So no heart rate is being displayed at all. And I assume it won't sync that data to the app, correct?
It won't sync what it can't read. The whole device is basically useless to me. Listen, I don't have time to troubleshoot. Can I return this defective product or not?
Yes, absolutely. My apologies. Let me just check our policy against your delivery date. One moment... Okay, I see it was delivered 18 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window.
Fine. How do I do it?

I am processing the full refund for you right now. I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to the address on file. Since you received a defective unit and you're a VIP member, I've also added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account for the trouble.
Okay. I just got the email with the label. That's fine. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Jordan. Once we receive the device, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
